notes: Seven bullets and only two places to stand: Exoroche (S) outside Southern San d'Oria (S) Eastgate and Landeric in Jugner Forest (S), visited alternately. 'Exoroche (S)' and 'Exoroche' are TWO different entities and both appear on this page -- the normaliser folds the wiki's '(S)' to the client's '[S]', so they get different keys, and the zones (80 vs 230) separate them besides; getting that wrong would put the whole quest in the present day. The two '(Optional)' sub-bullets under bullet 1 name real NPCs with real grids -- the present-day Exoroche and Ailbeche -- so they are kept as optional steps sharing a group rather than dropped as commentary; they are the same shape as the optional clue NPCs in 'As Thick as Thieves', and grouping them makes both draw at once since the page implies no order. The Bronze Sword is evidence on step 5 and nowhere else: bullet 4 has Exoroche hand it straight back, and bullet 5 hands it back again if you pick the wrong dialogue, so making it evidence a second time would jump the mark to the end of the quest the instant Exoroche first gave it to you. Trainee's Specs. is the header's Reward, so step 8 carries none. Bullet 7 is a cosmetic extra cutscene requiring the Trainee's Spectacles EQUIPPED; 'equipped' is not something the addon can distinguish from 'held', so it is recorded as an optional step with the item in items and the distinction left in this note.

notes: Eight bullets, three steps. Bullets 3 and 4 are the SAME trade written twice -- a Deathball pays 700 gil and a Sobbing Fungus 500 -- so they merge into one step with the fungus as items_alt rather than becoming two rungs you can only ever climb one of. The header's own Item Reqs already say 'Deathball -or- Sobbing Fungus'. The Stationery Set and the gil are the Reward, so nothing after step 1 carries evidence; the Herb Seeds Mashuu-Ajuu hands over at bullet 1 do, and bullet 7 says you never get them again, which is honest but harmless -- evidence only has to be true the first time through, and step 2's produce carries the ladder on repeats. Step 2 has no target: bullet 2 offers three routes (grow the seeds, buy off the Auction House, or buy a Sobbing Fungus from Soupox in Leafallia for 60 gil) and pointing at one of them would assert a choice the page does not make. The other students in bullet 1's sub-bullet are never named, so they are not steps. The unnumbered line above bullet 1 is a real gate the schema cannot hold: at Windurst fame 4 or higher you are given 'Let Sleeping Dogs Lie' instead and cannot start this at all -- an UPPER bound where gates.fame.level is a minimum. Bullets 5 to 8 are repeat rules and a gil-per-turn-in calculation, not steps.

notes: Six bullets, three steps, and a clean key-item chain the whole way. Bullet 2 is not a step -- it is the OUTCOME of bullet 1 -- so the Vat of martello fuel becomes step 1's evidence. Bullets 3, 4 and 5 are one interaction with one martello: find it, choose 'Prepare to replenish martello', confirm, then stand where the MENU says rather than where the log says, which the page flatly states disagree. The page names no particular martello and no grid, only 'usually around the various Confluxes' with a pointer at the Martello page, so the step carries the zone alone; 'Martello' is the entity's own name and folds to a real key, so it still marks. The [KI] Empty fuel vat that silently replaces the fuel vat is admitted only in a sub-bullet of bullet 5, and it is exactly what makes the hand-in observable. 'Machine Outfitter (Konschtat)' folds to the bare 'machine outfitter', which is a different entity in every Abyssea zone, so every step keeps its zone to separate them. Two things the ladder cannot see: the one-completion-per-Vana'dielian-day cap shared with A Mightier Martello across all of Abyssea, and the rule that zoning at any point destroys the key item and restarts the quest.

notes: Four bullets, four steps, and one place the page is wrong about itself. Bullet 3 sends you to the Earth Protocrystal but the walkthrough never names the zone it stands in; the only zone the page offers is the header description's 'the protocrystal in the Quicksand Caves', and that is the way IN -- the protocrystal is past that zone line, not in the caves -- so the step is deliberately left with no zone rather than pinned to a wrong one. That costs nothing: 'earth protocrystal' is not an ambiguous key, so the marker finds it wherever it stands, whereas a wrong zone would hide it. The arena of bullet 4 is unnamed for the same reason; Notes bullet 6 calls it only 'the Cloister'. 'Quest Reqs: Summoner Level 20 or higher' and 'Level: 20' are one gate stated twice and it is BOTH halves -- level 20 AND the job -- not a level restated for any job. Steps 1 and 2 are both Ferrol and so one marker; the fork is NOT consumed when you trade it to him (he teleports you), which is why step 3 can still require it. Everything under 'After the walkthrough: Notes' is restriction and tactics -- Carbuncle only, alone, 15 minutes, buffs survive the level cap -- and none of it is a step. Note 6 says you may re-take the fork and refight forever, but the header leaves Repeatable empty and the QUEST completes once, so repeatable stays false. Titan and the Scroll of Instant Warp are the Reward, so the fight carries no evidence.

steps.note: he transports you and gives the fork back; prepare first, because you fight alone under a level cap. On a repeat he will no longer teleport you and you must walk in.

notes:
Three bullets, three steps, and almost everything that matters is off this page. The header's giver is 'Alberic, Xarcabard', but bullet 1 says you EXAMINE the Cavernous Maw at (H-8) and merely get a cutscene WITH Alberic -- the same shape as the Summoner AF quests where Carbuncle is the cutscene and the House of the Hero is the thing you click -- so start is moved to the maw and flagged. Both sit in Xarcabard, so if Alberic does stand there in the flesh nothing is lost by pointing at the maw instead, and if he does not, this is the difference between a marker and none. The Traverser stone is recorded as a held key item even though 'Traverser stone' is NOT a unique name in res/key_items.lua and will therefore be dropped in stage C: it is a real requirement of bullet 1, and recording it makes the loss visible in the quarantine instead of silently absent. Bullet 2 gives no spawn method for Resheph at all -- it points at the Abyssea - Uleguerand flowchart -- which is why this quest is medium rather than high; the zone comes from the header description and that same sub-bullet, the only two places the page names it. Bullet 3 is a zone line, not an NPC: entering Xarcabard is the whole step. The nine-row table is a REWARD chart -- which Lunar or Ivory abyssite you get depends on how many Abyssea storyline quests you have already finished -- so it holds no steps and nothing in it is evidence.

notes: Six bullets, six steps, and the whole judgement is in bullet 4. Trading the Rusty Key to the Iron Door at (K-9) on the second map OPENS the room; picking a coin out of one of the chests inside is a second thing you do, so it is two steps and not one. The Ahriman Lens is the header's own Item Req and goes in at bullet 2, so it is items and not evidence; the Rusty Key and the Shelling Piece are each obtained on the step that carries them, one each, no repeats. Wights are recorded with role 'drop' and no count because the page gives neither. The 4,800 gil and the Night Sky Navigator title are the Reward, so the last step carries nothing. 'After the walkthrough: Related' is a link to the Stellar Map with a warning that star charts mirror east and west -- a reading aid for the answer key above, not a step.

notes: Bullet 2's three ??? collapse into ONE step, and that is the whole reading. They are all in East Ronfaure (S), the page says outright they may be checked in any order, and a ??? can never carry a marker -- so three rungs would draw nothing at all AND could not safely carry their key items separately: the ladder takes the LAST step whose evidence is met, so finding the Oxidized plate first would push the mark past the other two ??? and straight back to Mainchelite with two thirds of the evidence still in the field. All three key items therefore ride as one AND-list on one step, which reads exactly as 'you have collected the evidence'. Their locations are kept here because the emitted step cannot hold them: Charred propeller from the ??? in the SE corner of (H-8), in a hole of dirt; Oxidized plate from the ??? at (I-8) at the waterfall where the river splits on the map; Piece of shattered lumber from the ??? at the northwest corner of (J-7), in a bush next to a tree. Bullet 1's sub-bullets are not steps -- one says the quest switches your Campaign allegiance with none of the usual cost, the other that talking to Mainchelite again before the end cancels the quest. The Red recommendation letter is the header's Item Req and is handed over at bullet 1, so it is held for step 1 and evidence of nothing. Sprinter's Shoes (first allegiance quest only) and the Bronze Ribbon of Service are rewards. The header carries no Fame region and no FLevel at all, so both are null with the raw kept.
